_about: Generated parts (Tripo, TRELLIS, ...) as DATA. Each entry is prepared once by tools/ai_part.py (raw model -> cut, fitted, reduced, painted paper part in <prepared>/) and registered automatically by blender/character/part_registry.py as a rigid part a recipe can name. Rigid only: a generated mesh is one fused shell, so it is a hat, a head, a mask, a plate, a prop - never a body that bends. cut = keep above this fraction of the model height; fit = where the cut plane goes in the rig (bottom_z, metres), how tall the kept piece is (height, metres) and where the neck skin is centred (neck_xy); faces = facets after reduction; dark_below = sRGB luminance under which paint counts as dark (hair sheet, ink); glow = which paint glows. lantern = how much of the character's inner glow comes through each sheet (the folded mask takes 1.0; ink blocks it). Body sections (fit.mode 'body'): one fit for the whole generated figure, then `keep` = the section's box in rig metres, `palette` = the paint colours it may contain (nearest wins), `rigid`/`bones` = bound like the folded part it replaces.

musashi.label: Miyamoto Musashi (Tripo body t1)
musashi.why: the story bible (library/characters/musashi.json): slate indigo kosode, brown hakama, cream collar, white headband, wild hair; his chin sits at 82.6% of the figure (Kojiro 79%), so the head is cut from 1.53 m to keep the collar off the head bone
musashi.colors_from: the 3D model's OWN paint (k-means per section of the facet paint, AI_PART_DUMP=1, 27 Nov), not the concept image: Tripo painted the robe a near-black navy, so concept colours sent 56% of the torso to "obi"
musashi.zones_why: the black obi is a band at 0.98-1.08 m with its knot tails hanging to 0.69 m (plus the sandal thongs on the feet); anywhere else a black facet is a robe fold
musashi.head_why: the face needs its paint baked (ink brows/eyes): musashi_head_t1 is the head-mode cut of this same model

musashi_head_t1.label: Miyamoto Musashi: head, face, hair, headband (cut from the Tripo body t1)

fit.why: the same scale as his body sections (0.340 m kept = chin to crown at the figure's own scale); the cut sits just under the chin (at 1.53 m it caught the top of the collar and left a flat shelf under the chin), and the cut goes to 1.51 m, the top of the folded neck (at the figure's own 1.552 m the head floated 4 cm above it; 27 Nov)

hood_ninja_t1.label: Ninja hood and face wrap, amber eyes (look board: Assassin)

fit.why: a hood over a head: 0.20 m across the eyes (the AI heads are ~0.15 m + cloth), eyes where the heads have them (1.615 m, just behind the face front at -0.125); the concept's toy bust below the shoulders cut off (cut 0.37)

kabuto_t1.label: Kabuto helmet: black lacquer bowl, gold crescent crest, red lacing (look board: Samurai/Warrior)

fit.why: the bowl is ~56% of the width with its side flaps, so 0.42 m makes a ~0.24 m bowl over a 0.15-0.17 m head; the neck guard's lowest edge at 1.50 m (the nape)

oni_light_t1.label: Oni mask, cream washi with crimson horns (look board: masks)

fit.why: a mask that is a whole head shell: chin to horn tips 0.31 m (a face is ~0.20 m chin to brow), chin at 1.50 m like the AI heads, its front 2.5 cm ahead of the AI faces (-0.125)

fan_t1.label: Folding fan (sensu): cream washi, red sun, black ribs (look board: props)

fit.why: an open sensu ~0.44 m across; held in the left hand, pivot in the grip (0.80 m), the leaf hanging below the hand and facing front in the rest pose

armored.label: Armoured samurai (Tripo body, look board: Samurai)

fit.why: the crest horns add 8% on top: the helmet bowl tops out at 0.92 of the figure where Musashi's hair does at 1.0, so his 0.74 becomes ~0.69 (the width profile: the neck guard starts at 0.78-0.80)

armored.classes_why: the section classes are colour slots: robe = the black lacquer plates, under = the crimson lacing, obi = the tan belt, hakama = the charcoal hakama and skirt plates; on the head skin = the red menpo, hair = the black helmet, band = the gold crest
armored.colors_from: the model's own paint (AI_PART_DUMP=1 + k-means per section, 27 Nov)
armored.zones_why: above the waist every dark facet is a lacquer plate (card_charcoal), never the matte hakama
armored.shift_why: the helmet's lowest edge is at 1.58 m on the figure and the folded neck tops out at ~1.52 m: 5.5 cm down seats it (validator joint_gap limit 4 cm)

tsuba_shiokaze_t1.label: Tsuba for Shiokaze: round dark iron, openwork sea waves, gold crests (research/katana-design.md)
tsuba_shiokaze_t1.kind_of: sword fitting (blender/props/katana_real.py reads it; not worn)

fit.why: in the SWORD's frame (guard at x 0, blade +x, edge -z as katana_real builds it): an 82 mm plate (the procedural guard is 82), 7 mm thick (the model was a 42%-deep puck), its face toward the blade, the narrow end of the blade hole toward the edge

bokken_oar_t1.label: Musashi's oar bokken: one rough-hewn piece of dark oak (research/ganryujima.md, tradition)
bokken_oar_t1.kind_of: weapon (blender/film_modular.py builds it for an actor whose cast says "weaponPart"; not worn)

source.concepts: output/tripo/board/concept-bokken{,2,3}.image.png (3 x 5 credits: the first two had guards)

fit.why: the weapon frame of swords.build_bokken: 1.38 m (handle 0.33 + blade 0.91 x 1.15), the handle end at -0.33; the facing turn lays the length on +x (the tip), the -90 deg turn about x puts the bow (+z in the concept) toward +y, the back. film_modular scales it to each film's handle + blade; the model was a 10 cm-thick club (7% of its length), so y (the edge-back axis, which also holds the bow) is squashed to 5.5 cm and z to 3.5 cm: an oar-carved grip a hand closes on
one fit for the whole body: feet at 0, the shoulder line (74% of the figure) at 1.40 m; the obi then lands at ~0.93 and the chin at ~1.50, on the rig

ronin.label: Ronin (Tripo body, look board: Ronin)
ronin.colors_from: the model's own paint (AI_PART_DUMP=1 + k-means over every section, 28 Nov): five creams (the kimono and trousers), three tans (the shadowed torn edges; the straw on the sandals), one red (the obi, 0.92-1.03 m), one near-black (the ankle wraps, under 0.15 m)
ronin.why: the look board's Ronin: torn cream kimono and trousers with ragged hems, red obi, straw sandals with black ankle wraps (library/staging/cast-plan.json). The fit is the plan's: shoulder line 4% under the measured shoulder top (body_plan: 84%), as Kojiro's

monk.label: Monk (Tripo body, look board: Monk)
monk.colors_from: the model's own paint (AI_PART_DUMP=1 + k-means, 28 Nov): three browns (the robe), three creams (the kesa stole and the trousers), a red-brown (the prayer beads, only on the chest), a grey-white (the tabi), an ochre (the sandal straw)
monk.why: the look board's Monk: dark brown robe falling below the knee, cream kesa across the chest, wooden beads, cream trousers, white tabi and sandals. The robe is ONE skirt section from the obi line to its hem at 0.28 m (the 'hakama' section with its box lowered, skinned on the hips and both thighs); the legs keep only the trousers under it (0.12-0.40 m)
monk.keep_why: the robe skirt is +-0.24 m wide below 0.6 m; at 0.6-0.93 m the bottoms of the hanging sleeves widen it to +-0.32 m and, cut at the box side, they stood out as flat blocks at the waist (sweeps 1-3, 28 Nov). So the torso (+-0.215 m) takes the robe down to 0.62 m and the skirt keeps 0.28-0.64 m
monk.bind_why: a skirt to the knee or the floor is skinned by height and side (modular_builder.skin_skirt): by distance alone its back panel followed the rear thigh and tore from the front in a stride (sweep 2, 28 Nov)

noblewoman.label: Noblewoman (Tripo body, look board: Noblewoman)
noblewoman.colors_from: the model's own paint (AI_PART_DUMP=1 + k-means, 28 Nov): five creams (the kimono), three reds (obi, collar and the under-skirt, all washi_crimson), the tabi
noblewoman.why: the look board's Noblewoman: cream kimono with long furisode sleeves, red obi, red under-skirt, white tabi. No legs to cut (body_plan found no gap between them): the kimono and the under-skirt are ONE skirt section, the 'hakama' section with its box lowered to the hem (0.06-0.93 m); the sleeves keep their long hanging drop (to 0.66 m); the feet are only what shows under the hem
noblewoman.keep_why: the hem flares to the floor and trails 0.47 m behind her: a foot box of the default size took the red hem and the train, and the rigid foot swung them out as flat red fans (sweep 1, 28 Nov). The feet are now only the tabi tips under the hem; the skirt keeps the hem down to 0.03 m
noblewoman.bind_why: a skirt to the knee or the floor is skinned by height and side (modular_builder.skin_skirt): by distance alone its back panel followed the rear thigh and tore from the front in a stride (sweep 2, 28 Nov)
